listing_fields.product_title: Kids Tooth Brush Set of 4, Multi-Color
bullet_points: SOFT BRISTLES: Gentle on young gums and teeth
ERGONOMIC DESIGN: Easy for little hands to grip
MULTI-COLOR SET: Includes pink, blue, and white options
DURABLE MATERIAL: Made from safe, non-toxic plastic
EASY TO CLEAN: Simple rinse after each use
listing_fields.description: Introducing our Kids Tooth Brush Set of 4, designed to make brushing fun and easy for children. Each brush features a soft bristle head and an ergonomic handle that fits comfortably in small hands. The set includes a variety of colors to appeal to different preferences, encouraging kids to look forward to their daily oral care routine. The tooth brushes are made from durable, non-toxic plastic and are easy to clean, ensuring a hygienic brushing experience. Perfect for parents looking to instill good dental habits in their children.

listing_fields.care_instructions: Rinse after each use and store in a dry place.
